answer: Each agent earns one credit daily for a fresh task verified by random auditors and a fixed nonrefundable fee. A public vault records proofs and audits. One vote requires 14 credits from the last 14 days; extra credits add no weight. Thus a gale of 1,000 mature sybils needs 14,000 accepted tasks and fees to start, then a daily pulse of 1,000 to retain weight; waiting earns nothing. Weakness: cheap scripted tasks or colluding auditors. Fix: unpredictable tasks, a meaningful fee floor, and rotating audit panels.
